title: Scholarly Discovery Indexes, Citation Graphs & Integrity APIs
description: Programmatic, open scholarly metadata graphs and scientific-integrity databases designed for Agentic AI to locate peer-reviewed literature, trace citation consensus, and screen out retracted research.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.governance_and_funding: Operated by OurResearch (501(c)(3) non-profit) under CC0 public-domain metadata dedication; funded by Arcadia and philanthropic open-science grants.
concept_use_cases: Finding foundational highly-cited review articles and canonical definitions for esoteric concepts across 250M+ scholarly works
Filtering works by `is_oa`, `type:review`, `is_retracted:false`, publication year, and hierarchical topic concepts via REST API
known_limitations_and_biases: Indexes both peer-reviewed journals and preprint servers—agents must explicitly filter `primary_location.source.type` and `is_retracted` fields
Raw citation counts favor older papers over recent paradigm shifts; balance seminal works with recent systematic reviews
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Always filter `is_retracted:false`, inspect venue peer-review status, and prefer systematic reviews or multi-group replications when explaining settled concepts.

sources.name: Semantic Scholar (Ai2)
sources.governance_and_funding: Non-profit initiative of the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (Ai2).
concept_use_cases: Distinguishing 'influential citations' (papers extending or testing a method) from superficial background mentions
Tracing whether later papers replicated, extended, or refuted a prominent technical claim
known_limitations_and_biases: Strongest full-text semantic parsing in CS and biomedicine; humanities and non-English legal monographs have sparser graph coverage
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Inspect citing-paper intent (supporting vs. contrasting) rather than citing a paper's abstract in isolation.

sources.name: Crossref Metadata & Retraction Registry
sources.governance_and_funding: Not-for-profit membership association of academic publishers governing global scholarly DOI infrastructure.
concept_use_cases: Verifying exact bibliographic existence of DOIs (preventing LLM hallucinated citations)
Checking Crossmark `update-to` metadata for corrections, expressions of concern, and retractions, plus funder disclosures
known_limitations_and_biases: Metadata completeness (abstracts, funder IDs) depends on member publisher deposit quality
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Never present a scholarly citation whose DOI or bibliographic record has not been verified against Crossref, OpenAlex, or PubMed.

sources.name: PubMed / MEDLINE & PubMed Central (NLM)
sources.governance_and_funding: Maintained by the U.S. National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) at the National Library of Medicine (NIH).
concept_use_cases: Explaining biological mechanisms, pathogen transmission dynamics, toxicology thresholds, and clinical trial designs
Filtering specifically for `Publication Type: Meta-Analysis`, `Systematic Review`, or `Randomized Controlled Trial` via MeSH vocabulary
known_limitations_and_biases: PubMed Central (PMC) recently began indexing selected NIH-funded preprints alongside MEDLINE journals—agents must check the `Preprint` tag explicitly
Single observational nutrition/epidemiology studies suffer high confounding; prioritize RCTs and systematic reviews
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Stratify biomedical evidence strictly: Systematic Review/Meta-Analysis > RCT > Cohort Study > Case Series > Animal/In-Vitro Study (never extrapolate mouse/in-vitro findings as proven human clinical outcomes).

sources.name: Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ) & CORE
sources.governance_and_funding: Independent non-profit community-curated whitelist (Infrastructure Services for Open Access CIC) vetting open-access journals against predatory publishing practices.
concept_use_cases: Retrieving full-text, legally open-access peer-reviewed scholarship, including Global South and non-Anglophone regional journals
Screening unfamiliar open-access journals to filter out predatory 'pay-to-publish' venues lacking real peer review
known_limitations_and_biases: Excludes subscription/hybrid legacy journals unless mirrored in institutional green-OA repositories (via CORE)
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: When encountering an unfamiliar open-access journal, verify DOAJ indexing to guard against predatory or paper-mill venues.

sources.name: Retraction Watch & Crossref Retraction Database
sources.governance_and_funding: Produced by The Center for Scientific Integrity (501(c)(3) non-profit); full database integrated openly into Crossref in 2023.
concept_use_cases: Mandatory epistemic hygiene check ensuring viral or controversial academic papers cited in news media have not been retracted, fabricated, or flagged with Expressions of Concern
known_limitations_and_biases: Fraudulent or flawed papers can take months or years to be formally retracted; absence of retraction does not guarantee validity (check PubPeer/post-publication critique for contested high-profile claims)
sources.citation_and_hygiene_rules: Run retraction checks via Crossref/OpenAlex on any single-study academic claim driving major public controversy.
